QuestInfo.name: Rookie
QuestInfo.0: You open your eyes to find yourself inside an Old Storage Room. Maybe #bGen#k can tell you what happened.
QuestInfo.1: Why would Gen tell you to leave Grandis? This is a lot to think about.
QuestInfo.2: Memories of your decision to start a new life flood your mind. Maybe Gen's suggestion isn't all that bad.

0.msg: Boss... What happened? How long was I... Ugh, my head...\r\n

1.msg: #b(Gen says he followed you to Pantheon when he heard that's where the deal was.)#k\r\n

2.msg: ...I can't believe they'd do something so underhanded. Luckily, I was able to get you back safely.\r\n

3.msg: The way they attacked you... They may know who you are.

4.msg: I think you better make yourself scarce for a while. There's a whole new world in another dimension... It will be safer for you there.\r\n

5.msg: ...I can't promise that there aren't any spies in our own hideout. Think of this as a chance to train, really sharpen up your skills in another world. And above all...\r\n

6.msg: You're not the type to stay in any one place for too long. The Shadowdealers were good for you for a while...\r\n

7.msg: But you've outgrown us. If you want to get stronger, it's time to strike out on your own.\r\n

8.msg: A new world. No reason to hold back or fear getting noticed. There's nothing more I can teach you here, anyway. So, what do you say?\r\n

0.msg: I... I need time to think about this.\r\n
#b(You have a bad headache. Take a moment to compose yourself.)#k\r\n
